name: IRIS — Market: Filings Radar
description: Hourly at :20. Reads the SEC EDGAR daily form index for today and yesterday, keeps 10-K / 10-K/A / 10-Q / 10-Q/A only, dedupes by accession across runs via workflow static data, caps at 60 rows, and files each as an iris_inv_catalyst of kind=filing.

parameters.content:
## EDGAR daily form index, hourly
Reads form.YYYYMMDD.idx for today and yesterday. Today file is 403 until SEC publishes it - that is expected and simply yields nothing.
Fixed-width parse, keeps 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q, 10-Q/A only.
Cross-run dedupe by accession number lives in workflow static data, so an hourly re-read of the same index files never re-files the same filing. Static data only persists on production runs, so a manual test run can re-file rows.
Hard cap of 60 rows per run, newest first; anything shed stays unseen and is picked up next hour.
No fundamentals are derived here - that is a separate job.
